subject: general
question: _______ is a type of single thin sheet of metal that yields when pressure is applied and is widely used in most modern cars. When pressure is removed, the metal springs back to its original shape.
solution:
The correct answer is __Diaphragm spring__.

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Diaphragm spring__ is a type of single thin sheet of metal that yields when pressure is applied.
 
• It is widely used in most modern cars for its spring-back property when pressure is removed.
 
• These springs provide even pressure distribution and are commonly found in clutch systems.
 
• The diaphragm spring contributes to smooth operation and enhances vehicle performance.
 
• Its design allows it to maintain structural integrity under continuous use.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Leaf spring:**

 
 
• It is a suspension device used primarily in heavy vehicles.
 
• It consists of multiple layers of metal plates bound together to absorb shock.
 
 
 
• **Spiral spring:**
 
 
• It is a mechanical spring used in watches, clocks, and measuring instruments.
 
• It stores energy in its coiled form and releases it gradually.
 
 
 
• **Cushion spring:**
 
 
• Cushion springs are used to absorb vibrations and shocks in seating systems.
 
• They are commonly found in furniture and vehicle seats.
